name: Vignette-Framed Central Composition
prompt: Style: Vignette-Framed Central Composition: A tightly unified illustration style built on a distinct central cluster containing figure and surrounding elements together as one cohesive silhouette, generous negative space extending outward on every side rather than a continuous filled composition, the enclosing elements arranged deliberately to form an implied frame-like boundary rather than a naturalistic full scene, meticulous compositional discipline keeping every detail confined within that central shape while the periphery stays quiet and empty, and a poised, deliberate graphic clarity that treats negative space itself as an essential compositional partner. Influenced by: contemporary editorial-illustration composition technique, vignette-portrait framing practice, negative-space compositional design, decorative-border illustration tradition..
